title: Taming polyiodides: phenol chemistry for shuttle-free and durable zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8768-8779
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02763B, Paper
Zhixiang Chen, Xinlei Gao, Lutong Shan, Qingjin Fu, Zhenyue Xing, Peng Rao, Zhenye Kang, Xiaodong Shi, Wei Zhang, Xinlong Tian
Resorcinol (RSC) additive suppresses the poly.iodide shuttle and facilitates the conversion of iodine-loading cathode. Meanwhile, the RSC-containing electrolyte inhibits the interfacial side reactions of Zn anode, guaranteeing durable Zn–I2 batteries.
